Dialogs.Dialog: (Oh yeah! Maybe I'll ask her on that Hakone trip I won...)
Actually, I won again! Another trip!
Kobayakawa
Hmm...
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲？
I'm starting to get a little worried here, you know. Are you, like...？
...one of those hackers everyone's talking about lately, or something？
●？ No way...
Well, as long as you're not. So？ Is it Atami this time？ Nikko and Kinugawa？
It's Hakone this time! 'Rediscover Honeymoons: 2 Days, 1 Night'--
Wait, honey... What!?
It's a trip called 'Rediscover Honeymoons: 2 Days, 1 Night.'
A honeymoon... Look, you do know what that means, right？
A trip for newlyweds, right？ They say Hakone and Atami were big back in the '50s.
Apparently it's a couples' package for revisiting places like that.
Huh... I see.
Not too keen on going？ To Hakone, I mean？
Hakone itself is fine, it's just... you know...
The "honeymoon" part？
I mean, even I think about it a little, you know... I am that age, right？
Well, sure, but that's just the name. It's no different from our other trips.
▲主人公＊▲. Listen...
Yeah.
Maybe I will go after all... On that thing you mentioned. Y'know, the trip.
Hakone, 'Rediscover Honey--'
You don't have to say the whole thing!
...It's just a normal trip, right？ With that theme？
Yeah, exactly! You're overthinking it.
Yeah, maybe...
Guess I'll go, then...
All right！
So？ When are we doing this？
(Hmm, let's save our date for another day...)
All right, then. Starting ▲月▲▲日▲, a 2-day, 1-night honeymoon!
Hey, I told you!
...is the name of the trip, right？
Right, exactly. Still, well... if it's just a little bit...
I can play along a little, you know？ Like newlyweds... I'm not heartless or anything.
(Yes!! ● and ▲小早川＊▲, playing newlyweds!)
(Oh yeah! I won that Hakone trip again. Maybe I'll ask her to come along...)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Hm？
Actually, I won again! The 'Rediscover Honeymoons: 2 Days, 1 Night in Hakone' trip!
And there it is...
What do you mean？
The cycle？
It's that thing, right？ A loophole in the firewall system, or whatever？
You're still on about that？ Don't worry. I won it fair and square.
Let's just go with that. I'm ready to be your accomplice, after all.
So, what do you say？ You're coming, right？
Well, yeah, I'll go, but... I don't know about doing... you know, like last time.
Oh, playing newlyweds？
Yeah... Truth is, it gets insanely embarrassing afterward...
Well, don't push yourself. So, when should we go？
(Let's save our date for another day. Since this is a honeymoon and all...)
Alright then. Starting ▲月▲▲日▲, 2 days, 1 night in Hakone!
You mean honeymoon, right？
Wait, you're okay with playing newlyweds？
I'm not heartless, you know？ And I want to live up to my boyfriend's expectations？
Between doing it or not, well... I guess I'll do it？
(So you really do want to, huh, ▲小早川＊▲...)
(Alright!! A pretend honeymoon for ● and ▲小早川＊▲!)
(My phone... Oh, it's ▲小早川＊▲.)
Yes. Hello？
Kobayakawa
Hello？ It's Rinko.
▲Kobayaka＊▲, what's up？
You're free, right？
Well, yeah, I'm free.
Listen, you know how we're going to Hakone？
Yeah, the 'Rediscover Honeymoons: 2 Days, 1 Night in Hakone' trip？
...Well, yeah, that whole thing.
We're going shopping right now, okay？
(Guess I'll go meet her for now.)
What's up？ Do you really need to shop？ Aren't you used to traveling, ▲小早川＊▲？
That's different. This time, you know... it's that thing.
Hakone？
Not that part. You know... the other thing.
The honeymoon？
Well, yeah, that...
Still, it's just pretend... Do we need anything special？
Come up with something. You're the older one here.
Hmm...
Nope, it's no use. I can't think of a thing...
Me neither. Potato chips were about all I could come up with.
Don't people buy those for school trips too, though？
True. Hmm... Isn't there anything？ Like, something matching.
Like matching outfits？
I'll pretend I didn't hear that. How about a game where we team up over wireless？
That's not really very honeymoon-like...
Sigh... Whatever, let's just call it a day, okay？
Well, it's not like we have to buy anything.
True. Oh, right! I actually have a little shopping to do, so I'll split off here.
I can come with you. What're you buying？
Well, it's... You know, um... In spirit, I'm a bride, so I figured something new...
Never mind! You don't need to know! See ya!
(She's gone. ...Guess I'll head home.)
(Guess ▲小早川＊▲ isn't here yet？)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲, you're here already？
Kobayakawa
Um... well, yeah. It's been muggy all morning. And besides, you know...
Can't be oversleeping when we're newlyweds, huh？
Huh？ ...Wait, is that really why？
Kobayakawa
You're late! Brr... It's freezing!
I'm right on time, though. How early did you get here？
Well, that's because—
Because newlyweds can't afford to oversleep？
Huh？ ...Wait, is that really why？
Kobayakawa
Well, I mean... That's the whole premise, and it's about being in the right mindset...
I see... All right! Off on our honeymoon!
H-Hey, wait! Don't just blurt it out!
Kobayakawa
Hmm... Even my imagination has its limits, you know.
What is it？
No matter how you look at it, this train doesn't feel like 'that' at all.
'That'？ Oh, a honeymoon—
Keep your voice down, geez!
(Is ▲小早川＊▲ actually pretty into this？)
Oh! Is this it？ Are we taking this one？
Yep. The "Romancecar."
Ooh! Nice!
...Well？ Starting to feel more like 'that'？
Huh？ Yeah... I guess so. Heheh.
Kobayakawa
Ugh, nope, no way...
What's wrong？
It's way too everyday... Not 'honey' or 'moon' at all...
Well, until we get on the Romancecar, anyway.
Oh, right... I'm counting on you, Romancecar.
Whoa, the Romancecar really is nice!
Yeah. First off, it's got a cool name, right？ Heheh!
All right, let's hop on.
Yaaay!
These seats are so spacious!
Kobayakawa
It's nice! How do I put it... like, open and free？
Guess so. Travel does make people feel more open and free.
Right? Yeah, so that's why.
What's wrong？
I'm starting to get into that kind of mood. You know... a honeymoon, right？
(All right!)
Man... Limited expresses really are the best!
Kobayakawa
I know, right？ It really feels out of the ordinary. Yeah.
Does it feel like a honeymoon？
W-Well, yeah, but... that word is still off-limits.
Still...？ Then when is it okay？
There we go... Okay, you can say it now. You know, honeymoon... right？
(That's... kinda embarrassing...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, quick question.
What is it？
We've been going through town for a while now... This is the right train, right？
Unlike when we went to Atami, we're traveling inland.
Kobayakawa
Hey, speaking of Atami, we did that thing, didn't we？ You know... playing pretend.
Playing honeymoon？
Y-Yeah, that, but... Something feels different this time.
Why's that？
Well, I guess it's our mindset, or rather... it's the goal of our trip this time？
(So it's the goal now, huh...)
Kobayakawa
Oh yeah, speaking of Atami, you didn't want to do it. You know, playing pretend...
Ah... Now that you mention it.
This time, I'm making you do it properly, okay？ You're the one who brought it up.
(Playing honeymoon 'properly'... I'd better do my best...)
Kobayakawa
I see. I mixed up my memories with Atami. That makes sense...
You and I have gone on quite a few trips by now, haven't we？
Well, yeah？
My favorite trip is always the latest one we took. So I hope this one is, too.
Train Announcement
We will soon arrive at the final stop, Hakone-Yumoto. For the Hakone Tozan Line bound for Gora...
Kobayakawa
Did you hear that？ It said Hakone-Yumoto!
All right! Let's get our stuff ready!
Phew~! We made it! Hakone!
Kobayakawa
Huh... This is actually my first time in Hakone, you know...
It's really got that classic tourist spot vibe! Huh...
Well, it is Hakone! Let's go!
Hey, wait a second!
Hm？
Right now, you and I are doing that thing, right？ You know, um...
A honeymoon？
Should we stick closer together than usual？
Yeah, good idea.
Honeymoon▼ Hehe.
(I'm happy, but it's a little embarrassing...)
Phew~! Back in Hakone again!
Kobayakawa
Here we are in Hakone!
And with that... Ahem!
From here on out, let's give it all we've got, okay？ Our honeymoon.
Right. Bring it on, honeymoon!
Hehe▼ Honeymoon!
Kobayakawa
Oh! I see it, the red bridge!
Oh, there it is...
Kobayakawa
'Hydrangea Bridge,' right？ Yeah. ...So where are the hydrangeas？
The hydrangeas are... oh! Look, they're blooming along the riverbank.
Hm？ Where？ ...Oh, I see them! Thank goodness.
Even I'd like to hold back the snark on our honeymoon, at least.
Rather than a famous spot, all of Hakone started welcoming visitors with hydrangeas—
And I heard the bridge is kind of a tribute to that.
So June in Hakone means hydrangeas, huh？ Okay. I appreciate the spirit.
Hey, now...
'Hydrangea Bridge,' huh.
Kobayakawa
No hydrangeas in sight... Well, it is autumn.
Can't expect them this late.
Still, the autumn leaves are pretty. Nice contrast with the green river.
You're right... You're awfully positive today, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well, yeah. Even I can put a lid on the cynicism during our honeymoon.
...Think it'll last the whole trip？
That depends on... my dear husband, doesn't it？ Hehe▼
It's a bit early, but wanna grab lunch here？ Since we're in Hakone, let's see...
Kobayakawa
Ramen, maybe？
...We came all the way to Hakone, you know？
I want ramen.
You never waver on that... Wait, is there even a ramen place open around here？
There is. ...Probably.
Oh, look! There's one right over there!
There really is... Huh, Yumoto hand-pulled ramen, 'Haikara Chuka Nisshintei.'
Let's eat here! Come on, let's go in!
Owner
Welcome!
Huh... Feels kind of like a retro cafe, doesn't it？
Well, it is Hakone, after all. It's not just your average ramen shop.
Fair point... Have you decided what you're ordering, ▲小早川＊▲？
Let's see... Okay, I'm getting this!
Here you go! One sanma-men and one gomoku wonton-men!
Food's here! Hehe♪
Oh, yours looks really good too, ▲小早川＊▲.
Right？ Oh... Then, should we do it？
We kind of have to, right？
Here, say ahh...
That hit the spot! Ahh... I'm so full▼
It's a bit early, but wanna grab some lunch？
Kobayakawa
I'm in! When you think of Hakone...
It's gotta be this place! 'Haikara Nisshintei.' Come on, let's go inside.
Now then, what should we order today？
Sanma-men and chashu-men.
Two bowls!?
Well, there are two of us, right？
Clerk
Sorry to keep you waiting. Here's your sanma-men and chashu-men.
Give me some chashu♪
So that's what you were after...
What's wrong with that？ We're newlyweds, after all. I'll share some of mine too.
Here, say ahh...
That hit the spot. Nothing beats ramen in Hakone♪
Kobayakawa
Hey, we're getting on another train？ We're already in Hakone, right？
We're taking the mountain railway to Gora. We're headed to the Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
A mountain railway？ Huh!
You didn't read the itinerary at all, did you...？
I'll follow three steps behind. I'm a traditional Japanese wife, after all.
We're climbing a mountain in this？ It looks totally normal... I pictured something more rugged.
It's a famous mountain train, you know？ Come on, let's get on!
Kobayakawa
Next up is the Hakone Glass Forest Museum, right？
Yeah. On the Hakone Tozan Railway, all the way to Gora.
Oh, there it is! The mountain train!
Once you've ridden it once, it actually looks pretty sturdy, doesn't it？
Guess so, huh？
I'm counting on you to go all the way today too. I refuse to climb a mountain on foot, okay？
Kobayakawa
Hydrangeas! Look, there's so many in bloom!
Whoa... That really is pretty...
Amazing... We're riding right through the hydrangeas...
You had a lot to say back at Hydrangea Bridge, didn't you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I was completely in the wrong... Hakone with hydrangeas really is nice...
(▲小早川＊▲'s really happy. We came at a great time of year!)
Kobayakawa
Look at the fall leaves. They're so nice...
Yeah... Really feels like autumn, huh？
Autumn really is the best season for Hakone...
Oh, you're being unusually agreeable.
What's wrong with that？ It's our honeymoon, after all. Heheh.
Yeah, I guess it is.
A honeymoon where you just enjoy the beauty of Japan like this... is pretty great too, yeah...
(▲小早川＊▲'s really happy. We came at a great time of year...)
We're here! Last stop, Gora Station!
Kobayakawa
Huh？ Is it a little cooler up here？
We did climb pretty high, after all.
Yeah, we really did! Not bad for a mountain train, huh？ It worked hard.
Sure did. From here, we take a bus to the Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
What...？ Why couldn't the mountain train just try a little harder...？
Oh right, you don't do well with buses, do you？
Hm？
At times like this, why not show off how manly you are？ It is our honeymoon.
Want to link arms？
Yeah, I'll hang in there...
We're here! Last stop, Gora Station!
Kobayakawa
It's freezing! Just how high up did that mountain train climb...？
Come on. It feels like Hakone, right？
Brrr... Let's hurry somewhere warm!
Want to board early？ We're taking a bus to the Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
Oh, right... Ugh... But I haven't prepared myself yet...
Don't be so dramatic...
For now, hold me tight... That's part of a husband's duty, you know？
Hehe... Okay, I'm ready now.
Whoa, that's quite a steep hill...
Kobayakawa
Ugh...
▲小早川＊▲... Is it that bad already？
It's that bad...
Hang in there! We're almost there!
The next jolt might put me over the edge...
Hey! --Whoa!？
Ah...
...Are you okay？
Yeah... That got me through it. Hehe.
Announcement
Next stop: Hyoseki - Hakone Glass Forest...
Announcement
Hyoseki - Hakone Glass Forest. Please be sure not to leave anything behind...
Kobayakawa
Phew...
You hung in there, ▲小早川＊▲. We're here--the Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
Just so you know, that bus really raised the bar. This better be good...
Hey, look at that! A glass tree!
Oh, you're right. It's all sparkly... I wonder why？
Ticket Counter
Please enjoy your visit.
This is the ticket？ Huh... Pretty nice! Now I'm getting excited.
It's really well-made, huh？
Announcement
Hyoseki - Hakone Glass Forest. Please be sure not to leave anything behind...
We're here. The Hakone Glass Forest Museum!
Kobayakawa
Phew... I think looking forward to this is what got me through.
Look over there. The crystal glass tree is sparkling today, too.
Oh, you're right. And that's just the sunlight, right？ It's like magic...
Yeah. It's really magical...
Ticket Counter
Please enjoy your visit.
Huh？ It's different from last time. I'm gonna save this one, too.
Still as fancy as ever...
Kobayakawa
Wow... This is amazing! Way beyond my imagination...
The glass is great, and this place, too. Apparently it's all modeled after Venice.
Yeah... It really feels like Europe! Let's go look over there？
Oh, look at this! Glass hydrangeas! Aren't they pretty？
Let's see, "Ortensia," huh. Made of crystal glass... Two thousand beads!？
Two thousand beads!？ And it's handmade, right？
Putting them right next to real hydrangeas is such a nice touch, too...
Look, what's this？ Pampas grass？ It's made entirely of glass!
Glass pampas grass, huh... Let's see, 100 stalks with 100 crystal beads on each!?
10,000 beads... Oh, they sway in the breeze! That's some fine craftsmanship...
This is amazing! It's called the Corridor of Light!
Nine meters high, ten long. 160,000 crystal beads!?
160,000!? No wonder... The sunlight sparkling off it is almost blinding...
Hey, wouldn't it be a waste not to take a picture of this？
Okay! Get in the frame, ▲小早川＊▲!
You know, doesn't this kind of look like a wedding aisle？
Yeah, it kind of does, huh？
Hehe▼ Want to link arms and walk down it？
Kobayakawa
Mmm! It really is nice here! Especially after that bus ride!
Forget about the bus already. Is that mountain ahead Owakudani？ You can see the smoke.
Come on, let's go？
Oh, look at this! Glass hydrangeas! Aren't they pretty？
Let's see, 'Ortensia,' huh. It's got... 2,000 crystal glass beads!?
2,000 beads!? They're handmade, right？
Putting them right alongside real hydrangeas is such a clever touch, too...
Look, what's this？ Pampas grass？ It's made entirely of glass!
Glass pampas grass, huh... Let's see, 100 stalks with 100 crystal beads on each!?
10,000 beads... Oh, they sway in the breeze! That's some fine craftsmanship...
With how the sun's hitting it, the glare is making me see spots...
Whoa... Oh right, wanna take a picture？
Okay!
Well then, shall we walk on through？
Like we did last time？
It's our honeymoon, so why not？ Right, d-a-r-l-i-n-g▼ Whoa, that's embarrassing...
The 'Venetian Glass Museum', huh...
Kobayakawa
Huh... More than an art museum, it feels like a huge mansion, doesn't it？
Whoa, it's so intricate! A mosaic？ That's not painted, right？
'Millefiori'... It means 'a thousand flowers'. Said to date back to ancient Rome.
Ohh... Ancient Rome, you say？ Look closely, there're all kinds of flowers... Must be quite pricey, hm？
'Lidded Goblet with Dotted Floral Pattern.' This is amazing...
Says here it belonged to European nobility.
I see... Alright, I've decided.
If I were a phantom thief, this is what I'd steal.
Oh, look, they sell all kinds of glass stuff here! Wanna take a look？
Sure, just don't bump into anything and knock it over, okay？
What am I, a kid？
Huh... They have millefiori here too!
Kobayakawa
Glass fusing？ Huh, it says you can try it out.
Huh, so you arrange glass pieces and fuse them together... Wanna give it a try？
Let's do it!
Hmm, that's done, I guess... Now it all depends on how it fires.
Looks like it'll take a while before it's done firing.
Wanna take a break at the restaurant？
Kobayakawa
Oh, how thoughtful of you! You'll make a great husband! Hehe.
Oh, they're playing canzone music!
'Caffe Terrazza,' huh... Feels just like an Italian cafe, doesn't it？
Yes...
What's wrong？
Do you think the singer will come over here...？ They might make us sing.
I'm sure we'll be fine...
Clerk
Thank you for waiting. Here is your fruit tea.
Whoa, look at this! It's full of fruit!
That's a big serving, too.
Mmm, smells so sweet... Kind of feels like we're on a honeymoon, huh？ Hehe▼
Clerk
Thank you for waiting. It turned out beautifully, you know？
Kobayakawa
Thanks. Now then... how'd it turn out？
Hmm... abstract art？ It was supposed to be my face, so I'll say it's yours.
We've still got time. Want to look around a little more？
Kobayakawa
Sounds good. Let's head over that way. Look, deeper in the garden.
Kobayakawa
Whoa, what's this, a glass fountain？ It says 'Fontana'!
Wow... 45,000 pieces of glass, huh.
The numbers alone don't surprise me anymore, but... it's so sparkly...
Hm？ Look, there's a bell over there.
'The Bell of Vows,' huh...
Oh, so is it like... 'Cape Aijo' or something？
It doesn't really say anything like that, though...
Yeah, but look at the colors. And it looks like two people pull both ends to ring it.
You're right. ...Should we make a vow？
Yeah. Okay, my vow is...
Actually, I'm not telling. I'll keep it a secret...
(Then ● will make a vow with ▲小早川＊▲...)
"Get married!"
'We'll be together forever!'
'We'll have a real honeymoon!'
Hehe, I made my vow...
● did, too.
I bet we vowed the same thing... Since we're on our honeymoon, right？
Kobayakawa
The glass fountain! Oh right, it's just up ahead past this, isn't it？
'The Bell of Vows,' right？ What do you want to do today？
Hmm... yeah. Let's ring it. We have to do our honeymoon properly.
Have you decided on your vow？
(Alright, ● will make a vow with ▲小早川＊▲...)
'Make something happen on this trip!'
'Make this a real honeymoon!'
Hehe▼ We made the same vow, right？
Yeah... probably.
Hm？ Hey, wait a second...
Kobayakawa
Phew... So that was the Hakone Venetian Glass Museum.
Getting a little tired, ▲小早川＊▲？
A little. Feels nice, though.
Yeah. It's a really nice place, isn't it？
Yeah, I want to come again. Oh, is that our bus？
Looks like it. Ready to go？
Hmm...
Are you carsick already!？
No, not that. The secret vow from earlier. I want to know what it was.
Oh... that, huh？ Then ▲小早川＊▲ will tell you if you tell me yours.
Huh？ Um, mine is... Come on, you can pretty much guess, can't you？
(What kind of vow did ▲小早川＊▲ make...？)
Announcement
Next is the final stop, Togendai, Togendai. For the Hakone Ropeway, the pirate...
Hey, look, this is Lake Ashi, right!
Yeah, it is! It's huge...
Want to go a little closer and take a look？
Let's check in first. After this, we're just staying at the hotel.
R-Right... We're staying overnight...
What's wrong？
Huh？ Nothing. I just kind of forgot... It's our honeymoon, right...
(Hearing it put like that makes ● kind of nervous too...)
Look, it's coming into view. The 'Hakone Lake Hotel'!
Kobayakawa
Huh... It really feels like a resort, doesn't it.
Yeah, pretty stylish, huh？
I see... I was picturing something more like a hot spring inn, so I'm a little nervous, I guess...
I'll just stick close to my dear husband...
Kobayakawa
We're here! The 'Hakone Lake Hotel'.
Still feeling nervous？
Not really...
I'm not scared as long as I'm with my dear husband▼ ...Or something like that, hehe▼
Kobayakawa
Look at that... They have a chandelier...
You're right. Looks like this place has a European style too, huh？
Yeah... If I were Alucard, I'd totally ride on that chandelier.
What are you, Dracula？ ...Don't climb on it, okay？ I'll go check us in real quick.
Okay. Oh, wait a second--
What's wrong？
Um, since this is our honeymoon and all... Should we put down the same last name？
(Oh, right...)
Sorry to keep you waiting. I wrote it down properly: '▲苗字▲ Rinko'.
Ah, I see...
Front Desk
Thank you for waiting. Allow me to explain the hotel's facilities.
Your wife is welcome to step right this way, too.
O-Okay! Yes, please.
Hehe... They called me your wife. Guess I look the part？ Hehe▼
(That makes me a little bashful too...)
Kobayakawa
Oh right, this is it! The chandelier that looks like you could ride on it!
Don't climb on it, okay？ Alright, I'm gonna go check us in.
Oh, wait...
What's wrong？
You remember, right？ You know, about the name...
Sorry to keep you waiting. I wrote it down properly, see？ '▲苗字▲ Rinko'.
Ugh... It really does feel a little embarrassing, though.
Front Desk
Thank you for waiting. Allow me to explain the hotel's facilities.
Your wife is welcome to step right this way, too.
Oh, yes. I'll join my husband, then.
I called you 'my husband.' Hehe... Seriously, what？ Who do you think you are!
(▲小早川＊▲ has herself all confused...)
Here it is, right here.
Kobayakawa
Huh？ A Japanese-style room...
Oh, you're right.
Phew... That's actually kind of a relief...
I mean, if it's too much like a honeymoon, it's kind of stifling, right？
Is that how it works？
Of course it is. If there was a big bed with flower petals all over it—
Oh! Look outside! The mountains look so close!
(Did she get nervous again？)
Kobayakawa
Want to have some tea？
Yeah, sure. Let me—
Now, now. Allow your new wife Rinko to make it for you.
Here you go, darling▼
Oh, thanks.
Hehe♪
What's wrong？
Is it good？
Yeah.
This is kind of nice, you know？ Like an old-school married couple.
With a porch and all, where the husband reads the paper and goes, "Hey, tea!"
Yeah... Could be nice.
Try saying it. Go, "Hey!"
Hey, tea!
...Huh？ I don't know why, but that actually ticks me off.
We still have time before dinner. Wanna take a bath？
Kobayakawa
Oh, good idea! Having dinner after a bath feels so luxurious, right？
Men's is "Heaven," women's is "Sky"... Oh, isn't there an outdoor bath, too？
Hmm？
Too bad they're separate... Since we're supposed to be newlyweds and all, you know？
......Pervert.
Yeah, fair enough... Let's meet up in the lobby？
Pheeew...
An outdoor bath! Nothing beats being outside...
Daaarling？
▲小早川＊▲!？ What is it？ What's up？
Kobayakawa
Hehe, nobody else is over here, so I just wanted to try saying it.
There might be people on my side, you know...
Never mind that! Hey, is there a big cocoon thing on your side, too？
Yeah, there is.
Oh, it's a sauna. Rinko's gonna go try it out.
Oh yeah？ Maybe ● will try it out, too.
Hey, quick question. Should I wrap a towel around myself in the sauna？
A towel？ No, I think you're fine without one.
Got it. I'll just go in naked, then.
(I just pictured it...)
Kobayakawa
We can't bathe together, so let's just pretend.
I see.
How's the water？
It's just right.
